newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-STANGER, BRACKEN MAKE LIONS DEBUTS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-STANGER, BRACKEN MAKE LIONS DEBUTS.

text.p: Tony Stanger and Kyran Bracken will make their first appearances for the British Lions in the victorious touring team's final midweek match against Northern Free State in Welkom on Tuesday.

The pair were called into the squad as replacements, Scottish wing Stanger joining the party only on Sunday, while English scrumhalf Bracken makes his first start since being called away from a Caribbean beach to replace Rob Howley.
Jason Leonard captains the side for the fourth time on tour as the Lions look to take their tally of win on tour to 11.
The Lions clinched the series 2-0 in Durban on Saturday with a superb rearguard action which gave them an 18-15 win.
But coach Ian McGeechan dismissed suggestions on Monday that some of the uncapped players might be given a game in the final 'dead' test in Johannesburg on Saturday.
"The senior players met the management on Sunday night and the players had a meeting among themselves this morning. The result is that there will be no stopping now," he said.
"We will continue to look for improvements and build on what we have already achieved," added manager Fran Cotton.

However, with injuries bothering test players Alan Tait, Keith Wood (both groin), Eric Miller (thigh) and Richard Hill (calf) the selectors may be forced into changes when they name their final test team on Thursday.
Left wing Tony Underwood can stake his claim if Tait fails to recover in time while hooker Mark Regan could jump ahead of test reserve Barry Williams for Wood's place.

Neil Back, a second half replacement for Hill in Durban, can boost his claims with another demonstration of his brand of perpetual rugby motion while Rob Wainwright will hope to play his way back on to the bench if Miller fails to recover.

British Lions: 15-Tim Stimpson; 14-Tony Stanger, 13-Allan Bateman, 12-Nick Beal, 11-Tony Underwood; 10-Mike Catt 9-Kyran Bracken; 8-Tony Diprose, 7-Neil Back, 6-Rob Wainwright, 5-Simon Shaw, 4-Nigel Redman, 3-David Young, 2-Mark Regan, 1-Jason Leonard (captain).

Northern Free State: 15-Michael Ehrentraut; 14-Trevor Harmse, 13-Albertus van Buuren, 12-Tinus du Boer, 11-Willie Nagel; 10-Eric Herbert, 9-Jurrie Jerling (captain); 8-Morne Venter, 7-Eugene Delport, 6-Henry Kershaw, 5-Stephen Nieiwenhuyzen, 4-Koos Heydenrich, 3-Baksteen Nell, 2-Otto Wagener, 1-Kobie Applegryn.
